edges.reason: msg.sender is trusted for price calculation, hasMinted checks and token assignment in factionMint.
msg.sender determines flag owner eligibility and payment in huntFlag.
msg.sender is the recipient of the forwarded balance in collectFees.
tx.origin equality is used as anti-bot access control in factionMint.
tx.origin equality is used as anti-bot access control in huntFlag.
block.timestamp decides whether the flag is vulnerable to stealing.
block.timestamp drives holdtime and highscore accounting in _saveOwnerTime.
block.timestamp influences the flag steal branch evaluated in huntFlag.
block.timestamp is stored into _mintStarttime when the mint is opened.
collectFees executes a low-level value call to msg.sender, allowing reentrant calls.
huntFlag delegates flag ownership changes to _getFlag.
_getFlag saves the outgoing owner's time before switching.
_getFlag calls _changeFlagOwner to move flag ownership.
_saveOwnerTime writes currentHoldtime and highscore into _factionData.
_changeFlagOwner rewrites the _flag struct.
_changeFlagOwner updates hasFlag and stolen fields in _addressData.
_changeFlagOwner updates stolen counts and holdtime in _factionData.
_transfer routes flag transfers (tokenId 0) to _getFlag.
_transfer routes faction token transfers to _transferFaction.
_transfer uses block.timestamp plus block.difficulty to randomize flag vulnerability.
_transfer reads and mutates the _flag vulnerable marker.
_transferFaction first removes the token from the previous owner via _removeFrom.
_transferFaction burns rogue or merged tokens via _burn.
_transferFaction reads and writes new owner AddressData in _addressData.
_transferFaction updates balance and id fields in _addressIDs.
_removeFrom mutates previous owner AddressData in _addressData.
_removeFrom mutates previous owner AddressID in _addressIDs.
The public burn function delegates to the internal _burn overloads.
_burn removes the token from its owner before marking it burned.
_burn increments the _burnedCount supply counter.
factionMint resolves or creates the faction through _addToFaction.
factionMint writes the minter AddressID in _addressIDs.
factionMint writes the minted FactionToken into _factionOwnerships.
factionMint advances the _currentIndex supply pointer.
factionMint burns the previous last token when merging ownership.
_addToFaction updates member counts and names in _factionIDs.
_addToFaction performs an external balanceOf call for reserved factions.
tokenURI invokes the external stolenImage generator contract.
tokenURI reads flag ownership state to build metadata.
_checkOnERC721Received calls onERC721Received on an arbitrary receiver contract.
startFactionMint sets the generator through setImageContract.
startFactionMint stores block.timestamp into _mintStarttime.
setImageContract assigns the external generator to stolenImage.
lockFactionMint sets the _locked marker.
flagVulnerable reads the vulnerable marker from _flag.
flagVulnerable compares _flagLastTransferTime against block.timestamp.
ownerOf returns the flag owner for tokenId 0.
approve restricts callers using msg.sender compared against token owner.
_changeFlagOwner updates current faction holding used with leader bookkeeping.
_saveOwnerTime updates _currentLongestHoldtime when a new highscore appears.

normalization_plan.reason: quantity is the batch-size parameter controlling the payable mint flow in factionMint.
factionName is the parameter consumed by factionMint before faction resolution.
tokenId is the parameter identifying the token burned by the public burn function.
success holds the result of the low-level value call performed inside collectFees.
newOwner is the recipient parameter of the flag ownership change routine.
stolen is the marker parameter branching steal versus mint behaviour in _changeFlagOwner.
ft is the mutable FactionToken copy handled inside _transferFaction.
imageContract is the parameter forwarded to setImageContract by startFactionMint.
currentMintPrice is the computed payable amount checked inside huntFlag.
no is the AddressData copy of the new owner written inside _transferFaction.
